Voice of America FAQ

What frequency is Voice of America on?
In the A-26 season Voice of America is scheduled on 72 shortwave frequencies, including 4930, 4940, 5860, 5875, 5885, 6090 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9310 kHz (1:30 pm – 7:30 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9310 kHz (6:30 pm – 12:30 am UTC+1).

Can I hear Voice of America in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9310 kHz (1:30 pm – 7:30 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Voice of America broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 4930 kHz at 12:00–14:00 UTC to Africa; 4940 kHz at 05:30–07:00 UTC to S. Africa; 5860 kHz at 07:00–13:00 UTC to E. Europe; 6090 kHz at 06:30–07:00 UTC to SE Asia; 7370 kHz at 07:00–13:00 UTC to E. Europe; plus 17 more.

Is Voice of America on the air right now?
As of Friday, September 25, 2026, 10:11 UTC, Voice of America is scheduled to be broadcasting on 5860 kHz to E. Europe. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
